definitions.explanation: Rock formed from the cooling and solidification of magma or lava. One of the three main rock types studied in geology, along with sedimentary and metamorphic rock.

examples.japanese: {花崗岩|かこうがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火成岩|かせいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一種|いっしゅ}→一種：01628_isshu⟧だ。
examples.english: Granite is a type of igneous rock.

examples.japanese: {火成岩|かせいがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦マグマ→マグマ：22084_maguma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|ひ}えて→冷える：01154_hieru⟧⟦{固|かた}まって→固まる：01928_katamaru⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Igneous rock is formed when magma cools and solidifies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{火成岩|かせいがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{分布|ぶんぷ}→分布：00021_bunpu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because Japan has many volcanoes, igneous rock is widely distributed throughout the country.

notes:
Composed of {火成|かせい} (fire-formed) and {岩|がん} (rock). One of the three fundamental rock classifications taught in Japanese science education, alongside ⟦{堆積岩|たいせきがん}→堆積岩：23353_taisekigan⟧ (sedimentary rock) and ⟦{変成岩|へんせいがん}→変成岩：26132_henseigan⟧ (metamorphic rock).

{火成岩|かせいがん} is further divided into two main categories depending on where the magma cooled:
- {火山岩|かざんがん} (volcanic rock): cooled quickly at or near the surface, with fine-grained texture
- {深成岩|しんせいがん} (plutonic rock): cooled slowly deep underground, with coarse-grained texture

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火成岩|かせいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: types of igneous rock
- {火成岩|かせいがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分布|ぶんぷ}→分布：00021_bunpu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: igneous rock is distributed
- {火成岩|かせいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: composition of igneous rock
- {火成岩|かせいがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧: to observe igneous rock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{堆積岩|たいせきがん}→堆積岩：23353_taisekigan⟧: sedimentary rock — formed from accumulated sediment over time
- ⟦{変成岩|へんせいがん}→変成岩：26132_henseigan⟧: metamorphic rock — formed when existing rock is transformed by heat and pressure
- {火山岩|かざんがん}: volcanic rock — a subcategory of igneous rock that cooled on the surface
- ⟦{岩石|がんせき}→岩石：20502_ganseki⟧: rock (general term) — broader term for any type of rock
